definition: Adopted sense (owner decision #1007, 2026-11-06): x is in potency to F in respect r exactly when x has capacity for F in r and is not actually F in that same respect: AdoptedPotency.InPotency InAct CanBe x r := CanBe x r ∧ ¬ InAct x r. The act predicate and respect are identical on both sides. Example: a knower who can contemplate but is not contemplating is in adopted potency to contemplation. A knower contemplating now can retain the capacity but is not in adopted potency to that very contemplation in the same respect. This is not receptive potency of essence to its received esse, or a power possessed during its exercise. InAct and CanBe remain framework inputs: capacity existence, causal efficacy, temporal persistence, modal accessibility and applicability to reality are not built in. The original free InPotency parameter is retained under DEF-INDEPENDENT-POTENCY for generic proofs and rival interpretations. New adopted configurations instantiate EVERY use by this defined function, including immutability and act priority.
note: Explicit interpretation adopted by the owner: https://github.com/moritzbrantner/truth-core/issues/1007#issuecomment-6685335011 . The available IX.6 reading STMT-POTENCY-IS-UNACTUALIZED-CAPACITY motivates this definition; the decision is not a new source attribution. Existing source claims remain attached to their own statements and interpretations. The same-respect non-overlap follows from F1 by ADOPTED-POTENCY-NONOVERLAP, not from an added potency axiom. This predicate relates a being to a respect; transitivity, asymmetry and well-foundedness are not applicable same-sort order properties and none is inferred. The abstraction bridge that an actual example is accurately represented by the supplied InAct and CanBe remains OPEN. Powers theories, receptive potency, Megarian constraints on capacity and Night/independence interpretations are distinguished by DISAMB-POTENCY.
